notes: Printed: 'Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' On the battlefield a player's side is control, not ownership (CR 110.2), and a leaves-the-battlefield trigger looks back at the object as it last existed there (CR 603.6c, 603.10a). Seat 1's Opp Charm is under seat 0's control when it goes to the graveyard: seat 0 controls it, so the Mystic gets one counter. Seat 0's own My Charm is under seat 1's control when it goes to the graveyard: seat 0 does not control it, so no counter. One counter in all, the Mystic is 3/3. The tree's trigger reads from_zone=Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU); before engine wave E3 the binder matched it against the zone's owner (binding._zone_matches), which a control change does not move, and gave none. From verification wave 4's open fault H05 (2026-11-17).
